verdict.rationale: Antigravity's own agent accepts images and documents as input: the SDK documents passing image and document attachments alongside prompts, and the changelog shows PDFs surfacing in the conversation sidebar. Its agents build code autonomously across editor, terminal and browser. Nothing documents an actual design-to-app flow, so the story is only implied by combining these pieces. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented sketch/image/PDF-to-app workflow, image or sketch attachment in the IDE or desktop app (not just the SDK), evidence the generated app works, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can generate a working app from a sketch, image, or PDF design

citations.quote: Pass rich multimedia file attachments (images, videos, audio, and documents) to the agent alongside textual instruction prompt lists.
External files such as Google Drive links, PDFs, and Office documents now appear in their own Documents section in the sidebar above Artifacts.
Edit, orchestrate, and build all in natural language. Tell your agents what you need, and they’ll work on getting it done.
